english: Why did you put the cup of water on the stone by the hearth? I put it there for the dead, who dwell below in the earth. Do the dead thirst? They thirst and they remember us. Is my grandfather among them? He is among them; he died last year. Will you still give water to your grandfather? I will give it and speak his name.
uncertain: h2ḱméni read as loc. of 'stone'; memnḗr as perfect 3pl 'remember'

english: How does a god give strength in battle? The immortals give strength to the man who calls on them. Shall I fight in battle? All mortals die; fame does not die. Imperishable fame you will win if you are bold. Will the men sing my name? They will sing your name at feasts. My name famous in songs? That ... your fame is great.
uncertain: h1áyeth2er read as 2sg middle subj. 'you will take'

english: Old man, do you hear the thunder? I hear it. Perkwunos thunders. What does he want? He seeks the serpent in the clouds. He strikes the serpent and lets the water loose. Does he still want our cows? He does not want them. We call on Perkwunos and pour mead for him. Youngster, were you afraid of that? I was afraid, and I call on him.

Where does Dawn go at night? She sits in her own house. Why does she come back every day? She comes back because she loves mortals. The daughter of Sky brings light to men and cattle. Does she die? She did not die and is ever young. Child, will you see her tomorrow? I will wake early and see her.
uncertain: ne mért aorist answering a present question

english: Brother, is the Wind a god? The Wind is the breath of Sky. He carries the clouds and the birds. Where does he dwell? He dwells in the rocks and comes down at night. Have you seen the Wind? No one sees the Wind, but you hear him in the oaks. Do you hear him now? I hear him; he walks in the trees.

Brother, why does the Moon grow and then perish? She dies and is born again. Who is her mother? Her mother is Night. The Moon shows us the season. Do we sing to the Moon? The women sing to her at night. Will you sing with them? I will sing with my mother.
